events.headline: Trump rejects Iran's latest proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz; oil jumps over 1% and equity futures slip as the conflict escalates
IEA September Oil Market Report: over 10 mb/d of Gulf output remains shut in on security risks, global oil production down 1.6 mb/d m/m, demand outlook cut further amid the prolonged US-Iran impasse

AI-driven memory chip shortage sends DRAM/HBM contract prices soaring (spot prices up ~700% y/y by July); Micron, Samsung and SK Hynix shifting capacity to high-margin AI memory with no relief seen before 2028
Fed hiked rates to 3.75%-4.00% in September (first hike in 3+ years) on persistently elevated inflation; 16 of 18 officials see at least one more hike this year
Treasury Secretary Bessent says US and China agreed to extend their trade truce by two more months, to Jan. 10, 2027, easing near-term critical-minerals/tariff escalation risk
